param.name: models_file
param.dialogReference: Path to the model list file created from the model setup step. The model list has columns for 'stream_id', 'model_dir', and 'status'. stream_id is the unique identifier for each model. model_dir is the path to the model run directory containing the Heat Source control file. status is a field identifying the model run status. There are three status values: running: the model is currently running. complete: the model run has completed without error. failed: the model run failed due to an error.

param.name: overwrite
param.dialogReference: If checked, runs all models regardless of status. Not checked skips completed models (status = complete).

param.name: concurrent_models
param.dialogReference: Maximum number of models running simultaneously. Defaults to 1, which runs one model at a time.
